slides.headline:
You describe
what you need.
slides.body: In plain language. No code, no jargon.

slides.headline: Goblin builds it.
slides.body: No template, no builder kit. Exactly what you described.

slides.headline:
And puts it
online.
slides.body: With its own address. Reachable by anyone you share it with.

slides.headline:
All from your
phone. Nothing on
your computer.
slides.body: Goblin runs in the cloud. Your device doesn’t need to do a thing.
